step1_analysis.description: A Gilbert-cell based analog multiplier used as a finite impulse response (FIR) filter tap for channel equalization and crosstalk cancellation. It multiplies a differential high-speed data signal by a differential DC tap weight to compensate for signal impairments.

paper_reference.title: Realization of Multigigabit Channel Equalization and Crosstalk Cancellation Integrated Circuits

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total * VDD. With ~2mA total bias current and VDD=1.8V, Power = 3.6mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply compared to the paper's 1V supply.
Depends heavily on the load resistor and parasitic capacitance of the output node N8.

ac_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain from data input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. gm ~ 1mS, Rout = 1kOhm -> Gain ~ 1 V/V = 0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical for a current-steering multiplier tap to have near unity gain or slight attenuation.

transient_delay.description: Propagation delay from input crossing to output crossing

sky130_expected.reasoning: Consistent with the paper's reported delay values for similar technology nodes.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC bandwidth, gain, and transient delay of the equalizer tap.

* Output Load
Rout N8 VDD 1k

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Data Inputs (Differential)
V_LABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5 pulse(0.8 1.0 0 10p 10p 100p 200p)
V_N6 N6 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5 pulse(1.0 0.8 0 10p 10p 100p 200p)

* Tap Weight Controls
V_N0 N0 0 1.2
V_N3 N3 0 0.9
V_N4 N4 0 0.6

* Crosstalk / Secondary Inputs
V_LABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
V_N5 N5 0 0.9

* Bias Inputs
V_N7 N7 0 0.9
V_N10 N10 0 0.9
V_LABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9

* Unused / Dummy sources from original testbench
V_LABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
V_LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
V_LABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 10Meg 100Gig
  let gain_db = vdb(N8)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10Meg
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(dc_gain-3) fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 500p
  meas tran vout_max max v(N8)
  meas tran vout_min min v(N8)
  meas tran vout_pp param vout_max-vout_min
  
  * Delay measurement
  meas tran t_in trig v(N6) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran t_out trig v(N8) val=1.4 fall=1
  let delay = t_out - t_in
  print delay
  
  quit
.endc
.end
